ai.title: Build a record type with AI
ai.body: Say what you keep a record of, what you note down about it, and the stages it goes through. You check and change the draft before anything is saved.
ai.placeholder: e.g. A site visit to a customer: site, customer, date, what was found. It is planned, then confirmed by the manager, then closed. It can be cancelled with a reason.
ai.drafted: Drafted by AI. Nothing is saved yet — check every tab, change what is not right, then press Save.

siteVisit.label: Site visit
siteVisit.text: A site visit to a customer: site, customer, visit date, kind of visit (survey or repair), cost, and a list of findings with a quantity. It is planned, then confirmed by the manager, then closed. It can be cancelled with a reason.

trip.label: Vehicle trip
trip.text: A vehicle trip: vehicle, driver, from, to, start date and time, kilometres, diesel amount, and remarks. A trip is planned, started, finished, then checked by accounts. A planned trip can be cancelled with a reason.

prescription.label: Prescription
prescription.text: A prescription: patient name, mobile, doctor, date, and lines of medicines with dose and days. It is new, then dispensed, then closed. It can be rejected with a reason when a medicine is not in stock.
